title: Request newsletter subscription
description: Propose a double-opt-in newsletter subscription without disclosing whether an email address is active or suppressed.

website.description: Honeypot field; a populated value is silently accepted without creating a subscriber.

rules.description: The submitted email address is valid after normalisation.
The reader has explicitly requested the newsletter.
The address is not on the suppression list; the public response remains non-disclosing if it is.
Existing subscriber state is re-read before creating, reusing or confirming a pending request.

success.description: The request was accepted without disclosing whether a subscriber record was created, already existed, was suppressed or was rejected as automated traffic.

rejections.description: The supplied email address is invalid.
